clips.title: The story
paras: In Bloodhoof Village, Mull Thunderhorn asks young Horde champions to help make a sacred cleansing totem. Goblin pollution is spreading through Mulgore's water wells, and natural predator claws will bind the land's primal strength into ritual wood.

Mull Thunderhorn needs natural claws to make a cleansing totem. The Venture Company is poisoning Mulgore's water sources through its industrial exploitation, and he works to craft a remedy. Prairie stalkers and flatland cougars roam east and west of Bloodhoof Village. Their claws carry the plains predators' natural essences, channeling their raw, uncorrupted predatory vigor directly into the totem.

Tauren tradition distinguishes hunting for sustenance or spiritual balance from the goblins' wholesale plunder. Mull says the native predators' pure way of hunting can help purify corrupted earth. Goblin machinery fouls the springs with oil and industrial waste, while the beasts' natural strength provides the spiritual catalyst to restore the Thunderhorn Water Well.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: To create the Thunderhorn Cleansing Totem, you must gather the claws of the predators of the Mulgore plains. Hunt prairie stalkers for their stalker claws and flatland cougars for their cougar claws, then return to me.
You will find the prairie stalkers and flatland cougars to the east and west.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Friend, do you have the claws I sent you to gather? The Thunderhorn Water Well grows more tainted with each passing hour!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Thank you, friend. The purity with which these beasts hunt is vital in the creation of the next cleansing totem.
The goblins will never learn the difference between contending with the land, and living in harmony with it.
